metadata.description: ipscout delivered as a single Claude Code plugin: a skill for probing network reachability and inspecting the local network from Python or the shell, in-process and without administrator rights.

plugins.name: ipscout
plugins.description: Ping, sweep, traceroute and interface enumeration from Python or the CLI, unprivileged and without a subprocess. Covers the library API, the JSON output for machine consumers, and the platform limits measured on Linux, macOS and Windows.
